summary: Refreshed after merging main at 30770cd (#191, agent 0.36.1: gorilla/websocket pinned to the GO-2026-6278 fix commit, ADR-0126; it touches only agent/go.mod, agent/go.sum, the ADR index and its changelog row v0.47.1, none of this PR's paths). The only change to this PR's content is its changelog row, now v0.47.2 with agent 0.36.1; checks rerun on the merged tree, govulncheck for the agent now reports no vulnerability, so go-security no longer blocks. Dependabot #190 moves the router image's base from python:3.14-slim-trixie to python:3.15-slim-trixie (digest 65a65fc7...; checked that the official docker.io/library/python:3.15-slim-trixie tag currently resolves to this manifest-list digest, Python 3.15.2 on Debian trixie). The bump alone could not build: PyYAML 6.0.3 has no wheel for CPython 3.15 and the Dockerfile installs wheels only, and test/selftest_container_image.py requires the image's Python to be one the locks are checked for. Changes on top, after merging origin/main 937f6cf: (1) tools/security/lock_requirements.py adds 3.15 to PYTHONS; this only widens what the checker demands (the container lock must cover the requirements and their markers on 3.15 as well; needed_deps also considers 3.15), it removes no check. (2) PyYAML 6.0.3 -> 6.0.4 in router/requirements-container-lock.txt (lock_requirements.py pin) and requirements-ci-lock.txt (lock_requirements.py resolve on Linux, run in the pinned 3.15 base image with PIP_CONSTRAINT holding every other entry at its locked version, so only PyYAML moved; header unchanged). Both locks list the same 75 sha256 values for PyYAML 6.0.4, verify-pypi confirms every hash is PyPI's and nothing is yanked. PyYAML 6.0.4 (2026-11-20, yaml/pyyaml release notes) adds Python 3.15, drops 3.8/3.9, fixes exponential merge-key expansion and bundles libyaml 0.2.6. Hosts are unaffected: router/requirements-lock.txt has no PyYAML (hosts use the distribution's python3-yaml). The router parses YAML only from the operator's config.yaml and roles.yaml (config.load_yaml, CSafeLoader, mounted read-only in the image) and the healthcheck reads config.yaml; no request data reaches a YAML parser. (3) Router VERSION 0.42.1, CHANGELOG row v0.47.2, docs/design and the still proposed ADR-0121 name 3.15. The Dockerfile's controls are unchanged: --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary=:all:, pydeps verify, pip check, imports, pip removed, uid/gid 10001, read-only program files. No new endpoint, configuration key, secret or trust boundary.

tests.command: bash test/smoke_container.sh --engine podman --image <local 3.15 image> --no-build --selftests (inside the rootful Podman machine)
tests.evidence: 71 router self-tests pass inside the image built from this tree (Python 3.15.2, PyYAML 6.0.4), STATE: passed.

tests.command: bash test/smoke_container.sh --engine podman --image <local 3.15 image> (build with Git Bash, start checks inside the Podman machine)
tests.evidence: Image builds on the 3.15 base with the container lock (hashes, wheels only, pydeps verify, pip check, imports). Passed: uid/gid 10001, no secret in the environment, --check of config.example.yaml, --init writes config.yaml (root:10001 0640), healthcheck.py reports HEALTH: ok router0.42.1, router runs as uid 10001 without capabilities, configuration and program folders read-only, state_dir writable, no errors in the log. Two checks failed in this machine only: /api/version on the published port and the POSTURE line at start; the 3.14 image from main fails both identically in the same machine, so they come from the local environment (systemd unreachable in the Podman machine, containers started with --no-healthcheck through a local shim). CI's container job runs the full script with Docker.
17 tests OK (fails without the PYTHONS change: '3.15' not found in the locked Pythons, as in the Dependabot CI run).

tests.command: python tools/security/lock_requirements.py check ; python tools/security/lock_requirements.py verify-pypi
tests.evidence: Python locks: 0 problem(s); PyPI verification: 0 problem(s).

tests.command: ruff check . ; python router/router.py --check router/config.example.yaml --pure ; python test/check_adr_index.py ; python test/check_pinned_references.py ; python test/selftest_control_flow.py && python test/check_control_flow.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; configuration ok; ADR index ok: 126 ADRs (after merging main); pinned references 0 findings; control flow ok, 0 findings. Rerun on the merged tree together with lock check, selftest_container_image.py and the public-data scan: all pass; agent govulncheck v1.9.0: No vulnerabilities found.
0 finding(s); added lines reviewed by hand: versions, hashes, image names and public release facts only.
No router code changed besides VERSION; the end-to-end suite runs on the host's Python, not the image's, and runs nightly in CI.

limitations: Trust in PyYAML 6.0.4 rests on PyPI's published hashes, the yaml/pyyaml release and CI's pip-audit; the wheels and the bundled libyaml 0.2.6 were not audited.
The base image is trusted by digest from Docker Official Images; its Debian packages were not scanned in this review.
Locally the published-port and start-posture checks could not run (Podman machine without systemd); they rely on CI's container job.
decision-embed stays on python:3.14-slim (#173): onnxruntime 1.32.0 has no wheel for Python 3.15; not part of this change.
